senses.gloss: m. pl. name of parasite worms, 1) in man.

units: <cite ref="Berakhot 36a:12">Ber. 36ᵃ</cite> <he>קשה לק׳</he> (some ed. <he>לקוּקָאנֵי</he>; ed. Sonc. <he>לקוּרְקְיָאנֵי</he>) it is injurious because it begets worms (tape-worms?).
